hypothesis: For a pitcher's first five appearances of a season, the official previous-five-game rate contains a mixture of a frozen suffix of the preceding season and already completed appearances in the current season. Combining that row-local statistic with the frozen pre-season suffix and the exact-C season counter can deconvolve the number and successes of pitches already thrown in the current appearance. This exposes a legal within-appearance state without grouping, ordering, or comparing evaluation rows.

semantic_audit.appearance_definition: pitcher_id within a game reconstructed from official chronological training rows; reconstruction is diagnostic only
semantic_audit.window_definition_to_test: previous five completed pitcher appearances across the season boundary
semantic_audit.failure_action: close the hypothesis without reading 2022 or later labels

legal_decoder.frozen_suffix: last five completed appearances for each pitcher from seasons strictly before the target year

selector.name: frozen_history_gaussian_boundary_posterior
selector.appearance_workload_mean_and_std: pitcher x game_type history with pitcher then global fallback

source_recipe_grid.direction: boundary current-appearance posterior minus exact-C E14 season posterior
source_recipe_grid.application: one nonnegative additive component, clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]
selection_order: maximize minimum full-score gain across 2020 and 2021
prefer smaller gamma then larger posterior_k

headroom_gate.on_oracle_fail: close the axis regardless of legal proxy metrics

legal_source_gate.on_pass: freeze the single legal k/gamma recipe before opening 2022 and 2023
legal_source_gate.on_fail: close direct correction; a learned feature follow-up is permitted only if the oracle headroom gate passed
